/keyboard-notes.title: Keyboard notes
/keyboard-notes.body: Piano note names repeat in a pattern. In the reference, middle C is named C4. Start by finding the white C key just to the left of a group of two black keys.
/keyboard-notes.example: C · D · E · F · G · A · B

/chords.title: Piano chord reference
/chords.body: A chord reference connects a chord name to its notes and a keyboard shape. The homepage example uses the A minor triad in root position.

/chords/a-minor.title: A minor piano chord
/chords/a-minor.body: A minor contains A, C, and E. This example uses A3–C4–E4 in root position. The numbers identify octaves, not fingers.

/scales.title: Piano scales
/scales.body: Use the scales reference to explore note patterns. The C major scale contains C, D, E, F, G, A, and B before returning to C.
/scales.example: C · D · E · F · G · A · B · C

/songs.title: Piano songs
/songs.body: Explore song ideas before selecting an arrangement. This prototype does not provide a song catalog or downloadable sheet music. The existing project supplies the actual content.
/songs.example: Find a piece. Choose an arrangement.

/songs/easy.title: Easy piano songs
/songs/easy.body: Use the easy-song guide as a starting point for choosing repertoire. Difficulty depends on the specific arrangement; a familiar title does not automatically mean an easy score.
/songs/easy.example: A starting point, not a difficulty guarantee.

/guide.title: Learn & practice
/guide.body: Start with the keyboard, note names, and the basics of reading. Learning guides explain ideas; this homepage preview does not include a course, progress tracking, or a practice account.
/guide.example: Learn one idea. Try it at the piano.

/guide/read-sheet-music.title: Read sheet music
/guide/read-sheet-music.body: A reading guide links the staff, written notes, and the keyboard. Illustrations on the homepage are decorative; they are not a complete reading exercise or a licensed score.
/guide/read-sheet-music.example: Connect the page to the keyboard.

/tools.title: Tools & printables
/tools.body: The tools hub brings together reference tools and prepared resources. This standalone file only implements the piano demonstration and chord comparison. Production links must follow the existing release manifest.

/keyboard-notes/chart.title: Piano notes chart
/keyboard-notes/chart.body: In the A440 reference used here, MIDI note 69 is A4 at 440 Hz; MIDI note 60 is C4 at approximately 261.63 Hz. Octave labels are not finger numbers.

/tools/blank-sheet-music.title: Blank sheet music
/tools/blank-sheet-music.body: This is the planned destination for the existing blank-sheet resource. No PDF is bundled with the homepage design. Connect the real, verified asset before offering a download.
/tools/blank-sheet-music.example: Use the existing resource, not a placeholder PDF.
